title: Zesty Crisp Polish Fish Fritters
description: Winey, crisp, romantic fish fritters with a bright lemon‑dill coating that melt in your mouth.
instructions: Preheat a deep‑fat pan or wok to 180°C and keep the oil warm.
Peel the potato and grate it finely, squeezing out excess moisture with a cloth.
Whisk together the flour, cornmeal, salt and pepper in a bowl.
Add the cod fillet, grated potato, egg, lemon zest, dill and wine to the dry mixture, stirring until a thick batter forms.
Heat the oil and drop spoonfuls of batter into the pan, frying 3–4 minutes per side until golden and crisp.
Use a slotted spoon to transfer the fritters to paper towels to drain excess oil.
Serve hot with a squeeze of fresh lemon juice and a drizzle of chilled white wine vinaigrette.
